privacy.title: ShopiDeck Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: The common privacy framework for shopideck.com and the ShopiDeck suite. Each app has its own addendum describing its data, permissions, providers, retention, and deletion. Using one app does not authorize processing by every other app.

sections.title: 1. Scope and app-specific addenda
paragraphs: This policy covers the public marketing website, contact and early-access requests, merchant administration, and common privacy practices. App functionality runs on each product's own surface; this website does not itself connect accounts, audit Klaviyo profiles, generate campaigns, or publish social content.

Read this policy with the addendum for each app you actually use. Specific addendum rules prevail for that app only; the Data Processing Addendum (DPA) governs processor obligations and mandatory law always prevails. An app's addendum cannot reduce another app's protections or authorize new purposes or data access there.

The addenda below are the current product documents. Upcoming products, including SEO That Sells, do not inherit another app's permissions or operating rules. Before a new app processes data, its own disclosures must be published and any necessary authorization obtained. Publishing an addendum does not guarantee that a product or every integration is already available.

sections.title: 2. Operator and privacy contact
paragraphs: ShopiDeck is a trade name operated by Andres Camilo Bonilla Carreño, a Colombian individual merchant, at Cra. 79A # 6-04, Bogotá D.C., Colombia. Contact for privacy, support, legal matters, and security incidents: team@shopideck.com.

The operator is the internal privacy contact, not a formally appointed DPO. ShopiDeck is not established in the EU or UK and has not identified a formally appointed representative there in these documents. No appointment or exemption from a legal requirement is asserted.

sections.title: 3. Roles and separation between apps
paragraphs: ShopiDeck is controller for its website, merchant relationship, billing administration, support, security, abuse prevention, and legal duties. It is processor when handling personal data on a merchant's documented instructions to provide an app. The merchant generally controls customer data and business materials it supplies. Each app addendum and processing schedule specifies the relevant operations and people.

Installing an app grants only that app's disclosed permissions. Data, OAuth credentials, customer lists, campaign materials, and usage rights are not automatically shared with, combined for, or repurposed by another ShopiDeck app. Optional cross-app features require a disclosed purpose, a lawful basis, and any necessary separate authorization. A common brand or shared provider does not itself grant access.

Requests are scoped to the identified apps, accounts, stores, and data. A valid request expressly covering several apps is handled across that scope; a no-data response from one app does not mean the entire suite has no data. Common legal, billing, or security records are processed only to the extent necessary and lawful.

sections.title: 4. Website, support, and early-access data
bullets: Website requests may involve IP address, browser/device details, requested pages, timestamps, and limited technical/security logs needed to deliver and protect the site.

The support form asks for name, email, store domain, selected app, subject, and message; it sends the request through Resend to team@shopideck.com. Do not submit passwords, API keys, tokens, or full customer lists.

Early-access forms on the Less Time Marketing page are hosted by Tally. When its widget loads or you open the external form, Tally can receive technical information; it receives submitted information under its own privacy notice. A request does not install an app, connect a platform account, or guarantee access.
App addenda separately describe Shopify account, catalog, Klaviyo profile, social-connection, AI input/output, or credit data. A category listed for one app is not collected by all apps.

sections.title: 5. Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: We process only data needed for the disclosed purpose. Under Colombian law, authorization is obtained where required, subject to applicable exceptions. GDPR/UK GDPR bases below apply only where those laws govern the processing. The merchant determines the legal basis for data handled on its behalf.

sections.title: 6. Use restrictions, advertising, and AI
paragraphs: ShopiDeck does not sell personal data, share it for cross-context behavioral advertising, use merchant customer profiles for its own advertising, or use app data to train its own AI models. Generating marketing content at the merchant's request is a Less Time Marketing service function, separate from ShopiDeck advertising.

Third-party AI use, data, providers, and verified limits are app-specific. ShopiDeck's own no-training commitment is not a guarantee about every vendor's retention or training terms. Bot Cleaner profiles are not authorized inputs for Less Time Marketing's generation providers. Automated action and human-review requirements are defined per app, not universally.
Apps are for business users aged 18 or older, not children. Do not supply sensitive or children's data incompatibly with law or outside the relevant app's disclosed scope.

sections.title: 7. Recipients and international transfers
paragraphs: Only providers needed for the website function or installed app receive relevant data. The register identifies scope, role, data, and location information. Connected platforms may be independent controllers rather than subprocessors for their own operations. Software libraries such as Prisma are not separate recipients.

Disclosure may also be necessary for legal duties, legal claims, advisers bound by appropriate duties, or a business transfer subject to continuing privacy obligations and required notice. These situations do not authorize unrelated app use or advertising sales.

The operator is in Colombia; providers may process abroad. Where required, an applicable lawful transfer mechanism must exist, such as contractual safeguards, applicable standard clauses, or a valid adequacy mechanism. This notice does not execute standard clauses or assert provider certification. Ask team@shopideck.com about locations, recipients, and safeguards.

sections.title: 8. Retention and deletion
paragraphs: Each app addendum specifies its own periods and triggers; there is no suite-wide scan-history period or universal 48-hour deletion promise. Website inquiries and support records are kept while needed to respond, manage the relationship, resolve disputes, and meet legal duties, then deleted or irreversibly anonymized. Technical records are limited to operational and security needs. Ask for applicable periods or deletion at the contact below.

Disconnection, subscription cancellation, uninstall, and deletion are different actions. Revocation stops new authorized access; local deletion follows the relevant app's flow and legal duties. Backups, statutory records, and minimum privacy/security evidence may need restricted retention and are not reused for unrelated purposes. Linkable pseudonymous hashes remain personal data.

Independent platforms may retain their own records. Shopify Files and already-published social content may remain after uninstall and must be managed there. Deleting one app's data does not itself cancel or delete another app unless the verified request also covers it.

sections.title: 9. Cookies, security, and incidents
paragraphs: The site and apps may use necessary session, security, or preference storage; app-specific cookies are described in the relevant addendum. The public site does not currently include Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, or behavioral-advertising tracking. External forms have their own technical processing. Future non-essential tracking requires prior disclosures and consent where required; this policy is not advance consent.

Measures include HTTPS, restricted access, server-side secrets, input validation, and encrypted stored credentials in relevant apps. Specific measures are in each schedule. No measure guarantees absolute security. Personal-data incidents are investigated; processor notifications to merchants are made without undue delay, and individual/authority notifications follow applicable legal duties and deadlines. Report suspected compromise to team@shopideck.com without sending secrets.

sections.title: 10. Rights and requests
paragraphs: Depending on law you may know about use, access, correct, delete, restrict, or port data; withdraw consent/authorization; object; request proof of authorization or review of automated processing; and complain to the competent authority. Rights are free except lawful charges and subject to legal conditions and exceptions.

Write to team@shopideck.com with your name, relevant app(s), store/account identifier, relationship to it, right requested, and description. Identity and authority are verified proportionately. Do not send passwords, tokens, API keys, full customer lists, or unnecessary identity documents. Identify all apps if the request covers several. Store customers should contact the merchant as controller; ShopiDeck assists for data handled on its behalf.

Where EU/EEA or UK law applies, rights include access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection, and complaint to the local supervisory authority. GDPR requests are normally answered within one month, with notice and reasons within that period for any lawful extension. We aim to answer other requests within 30 days unless a different or shorter statutory period applies.

Where California or other US state law applies, rights may include knowing/accessing, correcting, deleting, portability, using an authorized agent, and non-discrimination. ShopiDeck does not sell personal information or share it for cross-context behavioral advertising. Statutory procedures and deadlines take precedence over our general response target.

sections.title: 11. Colombia: inquiries, complaints, and authority
paragraphs: Under Law 1581 of 2012 you may know, update, rectify and access data free of charge, request proof of authorization and information on use, seek deletion or revoke authorization where available, and complain to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC). A legal/contractual retention duty may limit deletion or revocation.

Inquiries are answered within 10 business days of receipt, with a justified extension of up to 5 additional business days communicated with reasons and a new date where permitted. Complete complaints are answered within 15 business days counted from the day after receipt, with a justified extension of up to 8 additional business days where permitted. Incomplete complaints follow the statutory correction process. Complete the direct inquiry/complaint process before approaching SIC where required.

sections.title: 12. Changes and language
paragraphs: The dates identify this version. Material changes are notified through the website, app, or email as appropriate. New consent/authorization required is obtained before changed processing; continued use is not consent where express consent is required. Adding an app addendum changes only that app, unless a separately notified common change applies to others. Spanish prevails over the English translation where legally permitted, preserving mandatory rights. Ask the privacy contact for the version applicable to an earlier period.

sections.title: 6. Accounts, acceptable use, and platforms

Do not violate law or third-party rights, access without authority, upload malicious code, attack the service, bypass authentication or usage limits, or use outputs misleadingly. Relevant platform terms, permissions, API limits, and app-specific rules apply. A TikTok publishing approval rule or Klaviyo suppression rule does not become a rule for every app. Outages, revoked access, moderation, or platform changes can affect the service.

Material common changes are notified with reasonable advance notice; longer app-specific periods are respected. A financial cap or indemnity applies only if expressly stated for the app or in a signed agreement. Less Time Marketing's 12-month fee cap is not imported into Bot Cleaner or future apps. Nothing limits mandatory rights or legally non-limitable liability, including fraud or gross negligence where applicable.

Contact team@shopideck.com for service disputes, identifying the app; this does not bar competent authorities or courts. App response promises and statutory privacy deadlines apply.

Notices may be given through the relevant app, Shopify, website, or email on record. Assignment is subject to law, platform rules, and continuing privacy duties. An unenforceable provision is limited to the minimum necessary; the rest continues. Non-enforcement is not waiver. These Terms, applicable app terms/approved plan, DPA where relevant, and express signed variations form the agreement; unrelated addenda are not incorporated by implication. dpa.title: ShopiDeck Data Processing Addendum
dpa.intro: Common contractual duties when ShopiDeck processes personal data on a merchant's behalf. Each app's processing schedule defines its data, purposes, duration, safeguards, and providers.

sections.title: 1. Parties, scope, and precedence
paragraphs: This DPA is between the merchant as controller (or authorized processor) and Andres Camilo Bonilla Carreño, trading as ShopiDeck, as processor (or subprocessor as applicable). It applies only to personal data handled on the merchant's behalf, not ShopiDeck's own controller activities. It starts with the applicable app agreement and continues while that processing continues.

Each installed app's schedule specifies subject matter, purposes, operations, data categories, people, duration, measures, and relevant providers by reference to its privacy addendum. No schedule for an unused app is incorporated. This DPA governs processor duties over conflicting general commercial language; app schedules supplement technical details and cannot reduce these common duties or mandatory law.

sections.title: 2. Documented instructions and purpose limitation
paragraphs: Instructions comprise the applicable agreement, app schedule, authorized configuration/actions, and lawful written requests, including authorized transfers. ShopiDeck processes only on those instructions unless law requires otherwise, informing the merchant beforehand unless legally prohibited. It informs the merchant if it considers an instruction unlawful and may suspend that processing pending clarification. No sale, own advertising, own model training, or automatic reuse across apps is permitted by this DPA. The merchant warrants lawful authority, notices, legal bases, and rights in submitted materials.

sections.title: 3. Confidentiality and safeguards
paragraphs: Authorized personnel are bound by confidentiality or an appropriate statutory duty. Access is limited to necessity. ShopiDeck implements measures appropriate to risk, including access control, HTTPS, server-side secrets, input validation, encrypted stored app credentials, and app-specific safeguards in the schedule. Security controls may evolve without materially reducing agreed protection. No absolute-security guarantee is made.

sections.title: 4. Providers and subprocessor changes
paragraphs: The merchant gives general authorization only to relevant subprocessors identified for the used app in the register. Independent platforms are not thereby classified as subprocessors for all their activities. ShopiDeck imposes equivalent applicable data-protection obligations on subprocessors and remains responsible for their performance of those duties as required by law.

Proposed additions or replacements affecting the merchant's processing are notified in advance, normally at least 15 days before access, so the merchant may object on reasonable data-protection grounds at team@shopideck.com. ShopiDeck will seek an alternative or resolution; if none is feasible, the affected processing/service may be ended under applicable terms, without limiting legal rights. Urgent legally necessary or security-driven replacements are notified as soon as possible. Updating a list alone does not authorize a different purpose.

sections.title: 5. International transfers
paragraphs: Only transfers necessary for the relevant app's instructed purpose are permitted, subject to applicable law and required safeguards. Where standard clauses, UK instruments, or other transfer arrangements are necessary, they must be validly put in place; this public DPA does not by itself claim to execute them or prove provider certification. The merchant may request processing locations, relevant contractual information, and safeguards. A shared provider does not authorize cross-app data pooling.

sections.title: 6. Rights, assessments, and incidents
paragraphs: Considering the nature of processing and available information, ShopiDeck reasonably assists with data-subject requests, security duties, impact assessments, and supervisory consultations where required. Requests for merchant-controlled data are referred to the merchant unless law requires a direct response. Shopify compliance events are handled for the affected app; a no-data answer from Less Time Marketing does not erase Bot Cleaner's records.

ShopiDeck notifies the merchant without undue delay after awareness of a personal-data breach affecting instructed processing and provides available information on nature, affected data, likely consequences, mitigation, and contact, with updates as information becomes available. The merchant remains responsible for its controller notifications, with ShopiDeck assistance. Do not send secrets when reporting incidents.

sections.title: 7. Information and audits
paragraphs: ShopiDeck makes necessary information available to demonstrate compliance and permits or contributes to proportionate audits required by applicable law, including inspections by the merchant or an authorized auditor. Coordinate at team@shopideck.com, protecting confidentiality, security, and other merchants' data. Public documents do not replace mandatory audit rights; reasonable coordination must not defeat them.

sections.title: 8. Return, deletion, and survival
paragraphs: When processing ends, at the merchant's lawful choice ShopiDeck returns or deletes the relevant personal data, including copies, unless law requires retention. Coordinate return before uninstall where platform revocation would prevent export or deletion there. Local records follow the app's documented deletion flow. Backups pending rotation are restricted from ordinary use; statutory exceptions and minimal security/privacy evidence must be justified, limited, and not reused for unrelated purposes.

Independent Shopify Files, already-published posts, and platform-controlled records may require merchant action at the platform. Ending one app's processing does not end another app's lawful instructions. Confidentiality, justified retention, deletion, and other duties continue while applicable. Contact the general legal address for questions or requests.

privacy.title: SD: Klaviyo Bot Cleaner — Privacy Addendum
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how SD: Klaviyo Bot Cleaner processes personal data in the embedded Shopify app at https://klaviyobotcleaner.shopideck.com. It describes the current product, its limits, the parties' privacy roles, and the choices available to individuals and merchants.

sections.title: Documents applicable to this app
paragraphs: This document supplements the general ShopiDeck documents exclusively for SD: Klaviyo Bot Cleaner. Its data, permissions, providers, retention, pricing, and suppression rules do not apply to Less Time Marketing or other apps. For app-specific differences, this addendum prevails over the general text; the DPA governs processor obligations and mandatory law always prevails.

sections.title: 1. Scope and effective date
paragraphs: This addendum applies only to SD: Klaviyo Bot Cleaner, its embedded Shopify app, merchant and administrator accounts, support and privacy requests, and the operation and security of the service. It is effective on October 21, 2026 and was last updated on October 21, 2026.

The English text is a translation. The Spanish version is the prevailing version. Where legally permitted and there is a contradiction, the Spanish version prevails without removing mandatory rights applicable to the merchant or any individual.

sections.title: 2. Controller identity and contact
paragraphs: ShopiDeck is a trade name operated by Andres Camilo Bonilla Carreño, a Colombian individual merchant based at Cra. 79A # 6-04, Bogotá D.C., Colombia.

Privacy, legal, support, and security incident contact: team@shopideck.com. The internal privacy contact is Andres Camilo Bonilla Carreño at team@shopideck.com; this contact is not described as a formal DPO.

sections.title: 3. Definitions
paragraphs: In this policy, merchant means the Shopify merchant or business that installs or uses the app; administrator means an authorized Shopify user; profile means a Klaviyo contact record made available through the authorized account; suppression means the Klaviyo action that prevents marketing sends and is not permanent profile deletion; and ShopiDeck, we, or us means the operator identified above.

sections.title: 4. Privacy roles
paragraphs: ShopiDeck acts as controller for merchant and administrator data, account administration, billing, product use, support, security, abuse prevention, contractual administration, and legal compliance.

ShopiDeck acts as processor for Klaviyo profiles processed on the merchant's documented instructions, including scoring, results, confirmed suppressions, and privacy requests submitted through Shopify. The merchant generally acts as controller for its customers' data and determines the applicable legal basis for that processing.
bullets: The merchant must have a legal basis to store customer profiles in Klaviyo and give lawful instructions to ShopiDeck.
The merchant must provide its own privacy notices and handle customer rights requests when it acts as controller.
The merchant must review profiles and confirm a suppression before ShopiDeck sends that action to Klaviyo.
The merchant must have authority to connect the Shopify and Klaviyo accounts and must not use the app for incompatible purposes.

Derived data: normalized patterns used for detection, risk score, risk level, explainable detection reasons, suppression result, audit history, and suppression history.
Support, privacy, security, and operational data needed to receive requests, verify them proportionately, protect the service, and respond.

sections.title: 11. Klaviyo connection and permissions
paragraphs: The app connects to Klaviyo through OAuth, reads existing profiles and subscription information, applies rule-based scoring, and sends a suppression only after the merchant selects profiles and confirms the action. Current permissions are accounts:read, profiles:read, profiles:write, subscriptions:read, and subscriptions:write. The app does not request permission for permanent profile deletion.

Klaviyo OAuth access and refresh tokens are encrypted before storage. The merchant can disconnect Klaviyo from Settings. Disconnecting revokes and removes the OAuth tokens and connection while retained audit and suppression history remains for its retention period.

sections.title: 12. Scoring and automated evaluation
paragraphs: The app performs an automated assessment based on explainable rules. Possible signals include disposable email domains, unusual or apparently generated email formats, generic or incomplete names, missing data, repeated values, bursts of profile creation, shared email patterns, shared name patterns, shared IP patterns, shared phone patterns, and available subscription status.

The score is an estimate and does not prove fraud or that a profile is a bot. False positives and false negatives are possible. The result may classify a profile as low risk, needs review, or probable bot and shows understandable reasons for the classification.

sections.title: 13. Human review and significant decisions
paragraphs: The score does not create an automatic suppression. The merchant keeps the final decision, reviews the profile and its reasons, selects profiles, and confirms any suppression. ShopiDeck does not make legal or similarly significant decisions about an individual solely from the scoring. Results are not used for advertising, credit, employment, insurance, or eligibility decisions.
The app does not use opens, clicks, purchases, or browsing activity to declare a profile inactive.

Klaviyo: OAuth, account and profile queries, subscription information, and merchant-confirmed suppression.

Vercel: hosting and serverless functions; processing in the United States.

ShopiDeck uses the contracts and safeguards made available by the relevant providers when applicable. A merchant or individual may request additional information about applicable safeguards by contacting team@shopideck.com. The provider's terms, privacy notice, DPA, and any applicable transfer mechanism may also apply.

paragraphs: Redaction HMAC hashes are pseudonymized values, not completely anonymous data. They are used to prevent an identifier that was previously redacted from being stored again. They are deleted when the store record is permanently deleted.

paragraphs: The embedded app uses the functional or necessary cookie shopideck_locale to remember the language selected inside the embedded app. It lasts one year and has Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite=None attributes. It is not used for advertising or analytics.

sections.title: 8. Retention, disconnecting, and uninstalling
paragraphs: The following periods apply to this app's active local records. Earlier deletion on uninstall or a valid request takes precedence over ordinary retention. Disconnecting a network in the app removes its local tokens immediately and stops new publishing through that connection; revoking from the platform stops API access and is followed by connection cleanup. Uninstalling removes the app's social credentials and stops future jobs. Shopify normally sends shop/redact approximately 48 hours after uninstall; on that event ShopiDeck deletes the local store record and related app records. sections.title: 2. Service, approval, and automatic publishing
paragraphs: Less Time Marketing creates copy, hashtags, images, videos, and subtitles using third-party AI from store products, brand materials, and your prompts. It schedules and publishes to accounts you connect when the integration is available and authorized. AI output can contain errors: review accuracy, rights, and platform rules before publishing.

By default nothing is published without your approval. If you enable automatic publishing for a campaign, the app approves eligible posts one hour before their scheduled time and they may publish without individual review. You can disable it. TikTok is excluded: you must always approve each TikTok post and explicitly choose the required privacy, interaction, commercial-content, and music-use confirmations. Automatic approval in this app never authorizes automatic suppression in Bot Cleaner.

Generated media is saved in Content → Files in your Shopify store. The app deletes files it no longer needs while authorized. Once uninstalled it loses access and cannot delete remaining Shopify Files; you must manage them in Shopify. Publishing to a social network creates a separate platform copy that uninstalling does not remove.

dataDeletion.title: Data Deletion Instructions
dataDeletion.intro: Disconnect accounts, stop app access, or request deletion from ShopiDeck. Identify the app or apps concerned so that your request reaches the right records.

sections.title: 1. Request deletion directly
paragraphs: Email team@shopideck.com with the subject "Data deletion — [app name]". State the app(s), store domain or connected-account identifier, your relationship to the account, and the data you want deleted. We may ask for proportionate proof of authority. Do not include passwords, API keys, access tokens, or full customer lists. You can request deletion without first disconnecting or uninstalling.

We confirm scope, handle requests under the applicable legal deadlines, and explain any legally required restricted retention. You may request an update through the same email channel. A request covering one app does not silently delete another app's records; specify all relevant apps. Store customers should contact the merchant as controller, with ShopiDeck assistance where it holds data on the merchant's behalf.

sections.title: 2. Less Time Marketing: Meta and other social accounts
bullets: Disconnect the selected network in the app to remove its local tokens immediately and stop new publishing through it.

You may also remove the app's access from the connected platform's settings. For Facebook/Instagram, use Meta's Apps and Websites or Business Integrations controls for the account concerned. For Google/YouTube use Google's connected-app settings linked below.

To delete retained connection data or content records in ShopiDeck, send the direct request above identifying Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, or LinkedIn as applicable. YouTube authorized data is deleted within 30 calendar days of revocation or a valid deletion request.

Uninstalling stops app access and removes social credentials. Shopify normally sends shop/redact approximately 48 hours later; that event deletes local store records subject to the documented legal exceptions, rather than guaranteeing deletion of every provider copy exactly at 48 hours.
Already-published social posts and remaining Shopify Files must be managed in those platforms. After uninstall, the app no longer has permission to delete Shopify Files.
